definitions.explanation: A drug that causes loss of sensation or consciousness, used during medical and dental procedures.

examples.japanese: {麻酔薬|ますいやく}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{効|き}いて→効く：01932_kiku⟧きた。
⟦{手術|しゅじゅつ}→手術：03218_shujutsu⟧⟦{前|まえ}→前：02255_mae⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{麻酔薬|ますいやく}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{投与|とうよ}→投与：12894_touyo⟧⟦された→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: I was given an anesthetic before the surgery.

examples.japanese: ⟦{歯医者|はいしゃ}→歯医者：01696_haisha⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧{麻酔薬|ますいやく}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{注射|ちゅうしゃ}→注射：01665_chuusha⟧⟦して→する：00392_suru⟧⟦もらった→もらう：00520_morau⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧、{治療後|ちりょうご}⟦も→も：00484_mo⟧⟦しばらく→しばらく：01267_shibaraku⟧⟦{口|くち}→口：00560_kuchi⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{感覚|かんかく}→感覚：02593_kankaku⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦なかった→ない：01118_nai⟧。
examples.english: I got an anesthetic injection at the dentist, but my mouth was still numb for a while after the treatment.

notes:
A compound of ⟦{麻酔|ますい}→麻酔：10581_masui⟧ (anesthesia) and {薬|やく} (drug, medicine). Refers to pharmaceutical agents that induce numbness or unconsciousness for medical procedures.

There are two main types: ⟦{局所|きょくしょ}→局所：18743_kyokusho⟧{麻酔薬|ますいやく} (local anesthetic, which numbs a specific area) and ⟦{全身|ぜんしん}→全身：03313_zenshin⟧{麻酔薬|ますいやく} (general anesthetic, which induces unconsciousness).

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {麻酔薬|ますいやく}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{投与|とうよ}→投与：12894_touyo⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧: to administer an anesthetic
- {麻酔薬|ますいやく}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{効|き}く→効く：01932_kiku⟧: the anesthetic takes effect
- {麻酔薬|ますいやく}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{切|き}れる→切れる：01936_kireru⟧: the anesthetic wears off
- ⟦{局所|きょくしょ}→局所：18743_kyokusho⟧{麻酔薬|ますいやく}: local anesthetic

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{麻酔|ますい}→麻酔：10581_masui⟧: anesthesia — the broader concept or medical procedure, not just the drug
- ⟦{鎮痛剤|ちんつうざい}→鎮痛剤：15451_chintsuuzai⟧: painkiller, analgesic — reduces pain without necessarily causing numbness
- ⟦{睡眠薬|すいみんやく}→睡眠薬：28681_suiminyaku⟧: sleeping pill — induces sleep but is not used for surgical procedures
